simple.meaning: מִרְמָס (mirmâç) is a Hebrew object word meaning “abasement (the act or the thing).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 5:5. The surrounding context includes offering, covenant, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִרְמָס (H4823) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִרְמָס (mirmâç) / H4823 is traced through Isaiah 5:5, Isaiah 7:25, Isaiah 10:6, Isaiah 28:18 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard.
All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol † Sheol is the place of the dead. shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”
Then my enemy will see it,

definitions.full: H4823. mirmas מִרְמָס noun [masculine] trampling-place, trampling ; — absolute ׳מ Micah 7:10 +, מִרְמַס (Kö ii.1, 96 ) Isa 10:6 ; construct מִרְמַס 7:25 ; Ezek 34:19 ; — 1 trampling-place , ׳מ שֶׂה Isa 7:25 (|| מִשְׁלַח ), ׳מ רַגְלֵיכֶם Ezek 34:19 (figurative). 2 trampling , לְמ ׳וְהָיָה Isa 5:5 it shall become a trampling , be trampled down, so Micah 7:10 ; Isa 28:18 למרמס לו והייתם , compare 10:6 ; Dan 8:13 .
